description: From a one-paragraph product description, a non-interactive create-prd run saves a PRD under docs/PRD/ with REQ-NNN headings, Given/When/Then acceptance criteria and `Constitution compliance: passed`, and writes no implementation files. The fixture carries a minimal docs/standards/constitution.md because the Constitution Gate halts without one.
prompt:
csv2json: a small command-line tool that converts a CSV file into a JSON array of objects, for data analysts who currently do this by hand. --foreman

This is a non-interactive run: ask no questions, choose the recommended option for anything unclear, and save the PRD under docs/PRD/. Write only the PRD. Do not implement anything.
